title: 3.1.7a Lab — Place a Cube
description: Create a Cube at a specific position and set its color.

steps.title: Create a Cube at (2, 0, 0)
steps.instructions: In setup(), write `cube = new Cube(2, 0, 0)` to create a Cube two units to the right of the origin.
hints: The Cube constructor takes three numbers: Cube(x, y, z). Positive x moves right.

steps.title: Set the cube's color
hints: The .color setter accepts named colors like 'gold', 'crimson', 'deepskyblue', or hex strings like '#ff6347'.

requirements.title: Cube is instantiated
requirements.description: A new Cube is created with the new keyword.

requirements.title: Color is set on the cube
requirements.description: The .color property is assigned on the cube variable.
